limitations: Both allocations use the same A100 model and software versions; this is allocation-level rather than cross-architecture reproduction.
The full panel has two process repetitions except transformer training, which has six after a targeted variability follow-up.
GPU clocks and power were not sampled during every timed group; scheduler and clock-state effects can remain.
The panel reproduces representative early kernel claims rather than every later MoE and serving study.
model: Re-run representative fusion, native CUDA, GEMM, attention, transformer-training, and 8-GPU all-reduce benchmarks on a fresh single-node 8xA100 allocation with the same software stack.

source.new: two full independent-node repetitions plus four targeted transformer-training repeats
